text:
elaine: Quick sync — we need to lock scope for the Console Observability work targeting next release. Customers pushing for: per-route cost breakdown, tracing hooks for hot-paths, and error analytics with quick-failure fingerprints. I propose we prioritize: 1) compact cost dashboard + drilldown, 2) sampled tracing hooks + annotations, 3) lightweight error analytics (fingerprint + alerting). Need: launch acceptance criteria and any blockers by EOD Fri. @jun @sasha @micah
sasha: Agree with prioritization. Can we define acceptance criteria upfront? e.g. cost widget shows per-route 24h spend + delta, tracing hook adds <10% p99 CPU, error analytics surfaces top 5 fingerprints + sample stack. Also need migration/rollout plan.
jun: From infra: tracing hooks without sampling will blow CPU/mem on high-throughput routes. Suggest adaptive sampling config + an opt-in header. Ballpark: with 10% adaptive sample we see ~5% CPU overhead. happy to run perf sims.
micah: Design can ship a compact cost card + route drilldown. Mockups due Wed. Question: do we need per-route allocation by model variant? that's extra complexity.
anne: +1 from CS — BigCustomerCorp explicitly needs per-route visibility for their billing review. They also want alerting when cost/day exceeds threshold.
elaine: Good call. Let's make per-route by default, model-variant a stretch goal for GA. For alerts, define simple thresholds and a 'notify on slack/email' action.
sasha: Drafted acceptance criteria quick list:
```
- Cost dashboard shows per-route + top 10 routes, 24h/7d delta
- Cost card loads in <400ms on typical org (~100 routes)
- Tracing hooks: adaptive sampling enabled, default 10%, configurable per-route
- Error analytics surfaces top 5 fingerprints with counts and latest example
- Alerting: threshold rule + slack/email webhook
```
Can we validate perf impact with a canary (10% of traffic) during rollout?
jun: Yes — we can gate behind feature flag and route-level opt-in. Canary for 2 days then scale. I'll put together a perf test plan.
micah: One design note: cost card needs a lightweight drilldown path not the full console to keep load fast. We'll prototype a 2-click flow.
elaine: OK. Owners: Product=elaine, Eng=jun, Design=micah, CS=anne. Action items: Jun -> perf sims + canary plan (due Thu), Micah -> mockups Wed, Sasha -> finalize acceptance criteria doc Thu morning, Anne -> confirm BigCustomerCorp blocking asks Thu. I'll consolidate and send to PM review. :thumbsup:
ops-bot: deployment canary scheduled: feature-flag "obs-cost-hook-v1" -> 10% rollout on 1799995678 at 09:00 UTC Thursday
sasha: ack :+1:
elaine: thanks team — if no blockers we'll freeze scope Fri EOD.
